nodes.label: favicon.svg — Fire Icon (Bootstrap Icons bi-fire)
nodes.description: SVG favicon using the Bootstrap Icons 'bi-fire' flame glyph. 16x16 viewport. The flame path is filled with KFV brand red (#ec0928), matching the site's fire-red design token. Represents the brand identity of KFV Freising (fire department district association) — the flame symbolizes the fire service mission. Minimal, recognizable at small sizes.

nodes.label: KFV Freising Brand Identity — Fire Symbol
nodes.description: The favicon encodes the brand identity: fire service (flame icon), KFV red (#ec0928 = --fire-red CSS token). Used as browser tab icon and PWA icon.

nodes.label: Brand Color #ec0928 (--fire-red)
nodes.description: The favicon uses hex color #ec0928, which corresponds to the --fire-red CSS custom property defined in the sitepackage design system (main.css / tailwind.config.js).
